entries.f45bd257c2777bfb: Based on the medium-term management plan formulated in July 2024 (from the fiscal year ended March 2025 to the fiscal year ending March 2027), in the ocean shipping business it states that it aims to stabilize and maximize earnings through optimization of existing cargo, routes and vessels, and will advance efficient vessel allocation through acquisition of long-term contracts and shortening of ballast voyages. In the coastal shipping business, it states that it aims to improve earnings through optimization of contract unit prices and contract periods, and to expand the business through increasing crew members and increasing managed vessels. In its investment strategy, it states that, while securing a financial position capable of withstanding changes in shipping market conditions and the business environment, it will advance reinvestment in its main ocean and coastal shipping businesses.
